reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend exactly as getUpcomingDates does; the daily-weekend skip has no shared helper and is re-derived inline.

duplication.why: The 'daily schedules drop weekend occurrences, others are shifted' decision (isDaily && skipWeekend && isWeekend, then shift only when not daily) is written again after getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts already encodes it.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like it, though the weekend/daily date rule arguably belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: A hard-coded three-day window and a second copy of the daily-skip rule mean a change to weekend handling must be mirrored here; the dense one-expression flatMap/Set/sort is also hard to read.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The weekend shift goes through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no helper existed for the daily skip.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange re-expresses getNextDate's daily-weekend omission and non-daily shift branching as a flatMap filter with different shape.
